config.record_grain: One current registered company-name entry per ASIC Company Register snapshot row; historical-name rows are excluded.

fields.evidence: Help file p.7 defines Company Name as the company name on the ASIC register; p.10 says Current Name Indicator=Y means the shown Company Name is current. Sample row 3: MONAKA PTY LTD, indicator Y.
Help file p.7 defines ACN as a 9-digit Australian Company Number including leading zeros; p.7 explicitly says Type=RACN instead contains an ARBN. Sample ACN 000000019.
Help file p.10 identifies ABN as the Australian Business Number for the company and says 0 is shown when absent. Sample ABN 89000000019.
Help file p.7 data dictionary limits Type to APTY Australian proprietary company, APUB Australian public company, FNOS foreign company, and RACN Registered Australian Corporation. Sample Type APTY.
Help file pp.9-10 defines Status codes, including REGD Registered, DRGD De-registered, and EXAD external administration (receivership/liquidation). Sample Status REGD.
Help file p.10 defines Date of Registration as the date a company was registered, with DD/MM/YYYY format. Sample 08/01/1990.

unmapped_fields.reason: Company liability class (for example LMSH) has no corresponding assignment-subset canonical field.
Company subclass (for example PROP or PSTC) has no corresponding assignment-subset canonical field.
The ontology subset has no deregistration-date field; it must not be substituted for date_registered.
This is an original registration jurisdiction, not a current entity address state, and no registration-jurisdiction field exists.
Legacy state registration identifier has no canonical field; retain as a string outside this mapping if supported.
Dataset change flag is record metadata, not an entity attribute in the supplied ontology.
Used solely as the documented current-name row filter; no canonical output field exists.
Documentation says it is populated for historical-name records when Current Name Indicator is null; those rows are excluded, and this is not a trading name.
Documentation identifies it as the start date of the current registered company name on historical-name records; no canonical legal-name validity field exists in this MappingSpec schema.

limitations: The supplied publication proxy is used as the observation-time proxy; the help file says the extract is a snapshot and may not be accurate when accessed (p.2), so it is not asserted as the register snapshot/as-of time.
Filtering Current Name Indicator=Y intentionally excludes historical company-name rows. The excluded Company Name values are prior registered names, not evidence of trading names.
For Type=RACN, the ACN column is documented to contain an ARBN (help file p.7), so no ACN is emitted for those rows. There is no ARBN canonical field in the supplied ontology.
ABN value 0 represents no ABN according to help file p.10 and is excluded by the 11-character condition; identifier validators determine final emission.
Status mappings other than REGD, DRGD, and EXAD are conservatively unknown; a revoked licence interpretation is not applicable to this company-register source.
Authority and field-confidence assessments are provisional and require human review.
